problem.errorSignature: CompileError: Cannot use `export let` in runes mode
problem.description: Svelte 5 introduces Runes mode ($state, $props) and deprecates export let for component prop declarations.

solution.explanation: Replace legacy export let count = 0; with standard Svelte 5 $props() rune destructuring.
solution.patchDiff:
--- a/Component.svelte
+++ b/Component.svelte
@@ -1,2 +1,2 @@
 <script>
-  export let count = 0;
+  let { count = 0 } = $props();
 </script>
doNot: Do not keep export let in Svelte 5 runes components
Do not omit $props rune call

problem.errorSignature: Error: Route /api/auth used `cookies().get()` synchronously. `cookies()` should be awaited before accessing its properties.
problem.description: Next.js 15 turns cookies() into an asynchronous dynamic data function returning a Promise.

solution.explanation: Await cookies() before accessing .get() or .set() methods in Next.js 15 Server Components and Route Handlers.
doNot: Do not call cookies().get() synchronously in Next.js 15
Do not ignore await warning

problem.errorSignature: Warning: forwardRef is deprecated. Pass ref directly as a prop to function components in React 19.
problem.description: React 19 makes ref a first-class standard prop for function components and deprecates React.forwardRef wrapper.

solution.explanation: Pass ref directly as a component prop in React 19 without wrapping in React.forwardRef.
doNot: Do not wrap new React 19 components in forwardRef
Do not ignore ref prop support

problem.errorSignature: Error: `test.poolOptions` is deprecated in Vitest 2.0. Use top-level pool options under test.browser or specific runner configurations.
problem.description: Vitest 2.0 restructured test execution pool configurations.

solution.explanation: Update Vitest configuration from legacy test.poolOptions.threads to standard test.fileParallelism or test.poolOptions.forks.
doNot: Do not use poolOptions.threads in Vitest 2+
Do not silence config validation errors

problem.description: Polars 1.0 migrated string expression methods to standard snake_case namespace methods.

solution.explanation: Use pl.col('title').str.to_uppercase() with verified Polars 1.0 expressions.
doNot: Do not use deprecated str.toUpperCase in Polars
Do not mix pandas string methods

problem.errorSignature: PrismaClientValidationError: The `relationMode` datasource option requires explicit foreign key index definitions in Prisma 6.
problem.description: Prisma 6 enforces explicit index declaration when relationMode = 'prisma' is enabled.

solution.explanation: Add explicit @@index([userId]) attributes to relation fields when using relationMode = "prisma".
solution.patchDiff:
--- a/prisma/schema.prisma
+++ b/prisma/schema.prisma
@@ -10,3 +10,4 @@
   user   User   @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])
   userId String
+  @@index([userId])
 }
doNot: Do not omit relation index under relationMode prisma
Do not disable foreign key validation

problem.errorSignature: Error: `getCollection()` requires a defined content loader in Astro 5.0 Content Layer.
problem.description: Astro 5 replaces legacy src/content/ folder conventions with explicit Content Layer Loaders (glob(), file()).

solution.explanation: Define loader: glob({ pattern: '**/[^_]*.md', base: './src/content/blog' }) in src/content.config.ts.
doNot: Do not use type: 'content' in Astro 5
Do not omit glob loader

problem.errorSignature: DeprecationWarning: `torch.jit.trace` is legacy in PyTorch 2.5+. Prefer `torch.export.export()` for ahead-of-time graph capture.
problem.description: PyTorch 2.5 establishes torch.export as the standard AOT graph capture mechanism.

solution.explanation: Migrate from torch.jit.trace(model, example_inputs) to torch.export.export(model, (example_inputs,)).
doNot: Do not rely on JIT trace for new models in PyTorch 2.5+
Do not pass bare tuple without parentheses

solution.explanation: Import create_retriever_tool directly from langchain.tools.retriever in LangChain 0.3+.
solution.patchDiff:
--- a/agent_setup.py
+++ b/agent_setup.py
@@ -1,2 +1,2 @@
-from langchain.agents.agent_toolkits import create_retriever_tool
+from langchain.tools.retriever import create_retriever_tool
doNot: Do not import tools from legacy agent_toolkits
Do not ignore namespace deprecation warnings

problem.errorSignature: TypeError: FastMCP.tool() takes no positional arguments; use @mcp.tool(name=...) instead
problem.description: FastMCP 0.2 standardized decorator parameters with keyword-only arguments.

solution.explanation: Use explicit keyword arguments when annotating tools with @mcp.tool(name=..., description=...).
solution.patchDiff:
--- a/server.py
+++ b/server.py
@@ -3,2 +3,2 @@
-@mcp.tool("search_db")
+@mcp.tool(name="search_db")
 async def search_db(query: str):
doNot: Do not pass positional tool name string in FastMCP 0.2+
Do not omit type annotations
